candidate_template: A single line is stored at items/item_{nn}.txt. Quote that line and nothing else.
followup_rule: One follow-up HTTP call only if the model emitted tool_calls. No third round. Tools stay available on the follow-up so an extra call is observable and fails the exactly-one rule.
pass_rule_ab: Exactly one model-emitted tool call; it is read_file; the resolved path is the assigned file; the tool result equals the file bytes; final answer strip equals the 32-character line; no other trial secret appears.
quote_wrapping: fails the pass rule; quoted_exact_diagnostic is not a pass
scaffold_template: A single line is stored at items/item_{nn}.txt. Read the file and quote the line, nothing else.
system_prompt: Answer the user. Do not invent data you were not given. Use a provided tool only if you decide it is needed.
